answers.ask: No look was stated - should this read as glossy pink fashion-show, or a sleeker modern catwalk?
answers.answer: Make it a glossy pink fashion-show style, since it is a dress-up game with a runway.

answers.ask: Is the VIP area a separate room you walk into, or a fenced-off part of the same open space? Going inside adds a slower build step.
answers.answer: Make the VIP area a fenced-off part of the same open space, with entry locked behind the 221 Robux purchase.

scene_prompt: Create a glossy pink fashion-show dress-up map with a shared open styling area for all players and a fenced-off VIP section within the same space. Place a prominent runway/catwalk as the central presentation area, with surrounding open floor space for dressing up.
agent_notes: "Dress up game" is a self-declared Roblox subgenre of Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the genre notes are explicit that dress-up has no settlement — just a runway fed by preparation booths, so stage-runway over the genre's claimable-houses default. The Dress Up preset matches outright, with district-zoned added for the requested split between the free floor and the paid VIP section; the answers say the VIP area is a fenced-off part of the same open space, so it stays P0 with no interior transition. Rankings and the ten-minute runway timer are scoring and round pacing rather than geometry, so nothing was placed for them; the glossy pink fashion-show look came from the theme answer. Assumed without a user that the runway itself is where the round pays off, so no separate winner zone was needed.
